attributes.title: 2027 Mountain Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Harrah's Cherokee Casino Resort and Cherokee Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Mountain Veterinary Conference runs April 18 to 21, 2027, at Harrah's Cherokee Casino Resort and the Cherokee Convention Center in western North Carolina. The organizer promises more than 20 hours of live CE lectures.

Registration has a separate category for technicians, receptionists and support staff. The 2027 prices are still marked as to be announced, with an early-registration discount for sign-ups before March 1, 2027; brochure, hotel booking and online registration are listed as coming soon.

The page does not yet name the speakers, state board approvals or RACE status for 2027.
